reason: A DAST scanner must be able to scan targets with self-signed certificates; verification is disabled deliberately.
Target reachability probe against local/private practice targets, which commonly use self-signed certificates.
The shared scan client scans targets with self-signed certificates by design.
MD5 is used only to fingerprint page bodies for equality, not for any security purpose.
'/tmp' is a list of URL paths to probe on the target, not a temporary file on this machine.
Parses XML produced by the local nmap binary; a scanned host cannot inject a DTD into it.
